summarize_model_config: summarize the Conformer base model configuration dictionary with ImageClassifier backbone and head settings
review_model_config: review the model config dict for Conformer base architecture with drop path rate and label smoothing loss
build_conformer_classifier: build a python module to instantiate an ImageClassifier with a Conformer base backbone and ConformerHead for 1000 classes
create_train_augments: create a training config with Mixup and CutMix augmentation settings for the Conformer model
refactor_init_cfg: refactor the model initialization config to change TruncNormal std or LayerNorm constant values
